question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) to complete the following lettercluster series?

UME, OPG, ISJ, EVN, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First letter → Alternately (6) and (5) are subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Second letter → (3) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

Third letter → Increasing number series is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8dc5234b3d4fc4db260b6fbaffaaeb9b2923a5ee90b2ca52081e3ad65e545fd.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
